known_deltas: Threshold audit (0.3): v3.0 literals in config.legacy_verification with IDENTICAL defaults; no conflicts vs agent thresholds.
Refinements: log_event trace_id; metrics local/network timing; Retry-After -> max(backoff, header); llm_call.attempts; latency_ms = all attempts incl. sleeps.
LLM inventory (0.4): all LLM calls via DeepSeekClient; requests-direct only image_gen (Flux). _call_json failure channel preserved: {raw_response, parse_error}.
Wikidata quirks (live-verified): API errors = HTTP 200 + {"error":{...}}; search hit has no aliases; redirects parser supports list and dict forms.

Pleiades reachability (1.2): unreachable from dev network (TCP ok, no response); mitigation: defensive parser + tests/test_network_live.py (marker network). Client is hostname-based (https://pleiades.stoa.org/...) - NO hardcoded IPs (IP in diagnostics was DNS output only).
Trismegistos (1.2): no public API (SSL chain + 403 anti-bot) -> stub adapter (no_public_api); datasets deferred to Phase 2 backlog.
Fragment orthogonality (curator fix, commit a086a4b): is_fragment = source lacuna; completeness_score = extraction quality; aggregate needs_attention = is_fragment OR completeness < 0.5.
Scoring weights (curator fix, commit 9894be8): in CONFIG.entity_linking (AEON_SCORE_WEIGHT_*); rule/type weights remain module constants.

Verification 2.0 (1.3): package aeon/verification/ (base, detective, expert, logician, aggregator, verdicts, __init__). Legacy aeon/verification.py REMOVED (package supersedes it); root aeon/verdicts.py = shim to aeon/verification/verdicts.py.

verify_atom projection (1.3): legacy keys kept - consistency.score = cvi, grounding per-claim from detective details, hallucination_risk = 1 - cvi (abstained: from mean of all agent confidences), overall_verdict legacy bands via legacy_cfg; abstained -> 'unverified'. New keys: agents, combined, cvi, abstained, reasoning_trace. Signature unchanged (source_text, claims, entities, trace_id=None). check_consistency/check_fact_grounding/verify_cross_lingual preserved verbatim.

Taxonomy/agent rules (1.3): needs_review is aggregate flag only (NOT in NEUTRAL/agent verdicts); logician with <2 claims -> trivially coherent (no LLM call, by design); detective require_quote enforced; per-agent abstention on conf < min (0.85 detective / 0.75 expert) and logician coherence < 0.60.

Abstention rule (1.3 aggregator): negatives dominate -> contradicted; no positives -> abstained; positives mean < 0.50 -> abstained; needs_review when positives mean < 0.85. Neutral confidences do NOT lower overall confidence (fragments not penalized, curator rule).
backlog: LLM retry jitter (+/-20%) - apply at 1.4+ when concurrent atoms grow.
Pleiades offline dump adapter (Phase 2): snapshot cache/pleiades_dump.json, same interface as live client (curator 1.2 note #2).
Trismegistos data integration via datasets (no public API) - deferred after 1.2 stop-point.
Verification parallelization (stdlib concurrent.futures) - only if live 1.4 demo shows >30s/atom (stop-point #3 flagged, not measurable without API key).
Phase 2: linguistic_layers (Chain-of-Linguistics), focus.py (multi-focus), fragments.py (lacunae hypotheses), aeon/ancient/ packs (ancient_greek + latin priority)
Phase 3: .aeon v2 (verification trace, entity links, hypotheses; v1 read compat), CLI analyze/link/fragments, web endpoints, README v4 + docs/ARCHITECTURE.md
